WITH order_payment_agg AS (
  SELECT
    op.order_id AS order_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(op.payment_installments, 0) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_installments,
    ABS(SUM(COALESCE(op.payment_value, 0))) AS order_value_usd
  FROM order_payments AS op
  GROUP BY op.order_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN opa.has_installments = 1 THEN 'installments'
    ELSE 'no_installments'
  END AS installment_flag,
  AVG(opa.order_value_usd) AS aov_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_payment_agg AS opa
  ON opa.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN opa.has_installments = 1 THEN 'installments'
    ELSE 'no_installments'
  END
ORDER BY installment_flag;
